title: Flying Over the F1 Circuit in MSFS 2024 | Melbourne World Update 21
description:
The wait is over! Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 has officially received the massive World Update 21, and Melbourne has never looked better. In this flight, we explore the brand-new photogrammetry (TIN) provided by the latest data switch, and the level of detail in the CBD is absolutely next-level.

We take a low-level pass over the Albert Park Formula 1 Circuit to see the pits and the track layout, check out the iconic Melbourne stadia under the morning lights, and discuss whether the performance stutters are finally fixed.

In this video:

The Switch: Analyzing the new photogrammetry provider's impact on city detail.

F1 Fans: A close-up look at the Albert Park Circuit (Melbourne GP).

Realism: Night lighting, ship traffic, and the "Blue Mountains" mentioned by the community.

Performance: A real-world look at stutters and FPS during low-altitude city flying.

Is this the quality we expected from Asobo? Drop a comment below with your favorite Australian spot to fly!
